description: Remove the background from a video given by public URL. Returns a job; when wait is true (default) the tool polls for up to 50 seconds and returns the finished job with result_url (a direct download link valid for 24 hours). For longer videos call get_job with the returned job id until status is completed. Costs 5 credits per second of video, rounded up (10 per second above 30 fps; animated GIFs are always 5 per second), charged when the job is accepted and refunded if it fails.

bg_color.description: Background color (hex, rgb, or color name) used when the output has no transparency (channels 'rgb' or format 'mp4'). Defaults to white. Example: '#00ff00' for green screen

channels.description: 'rgba' for a transparent video, 'rgb' for an opaque video on bg_color, 'alpha' for a grayscale matte video (no audio)

format.description: Output container. 'webm' (VP9) and 'mov' (ProRes 4444) keep transparency; 'mp4' (H.264) has no alpha and is composited onto bg_color; 'gif' is a looping GIF with 1-bit transparency and no audio, capped at 1280 px on the longest side (720p for widescreen) and 50 fps (large files, soft edges are hard-cut) for stickers, chat and email: use size 'preview' for sticker-sized output

size.description: Output size preset. The longest side is capped at 640 (preview), 1280 (medium) or 1920 (hd) pixels; full keeps the source resolution up to 4096 pixels (4K)

video_url.description: Public https URL of the video (mp4, mov, webm, m4v, mkv or animated gif; up to 500 MB and 5 minutes)

wait.description: Poll until the job finishes (up to 50 seconds) before returning. Set to false to get the job id back immediately

name: remove_video_background
title: Remove Video Background
